import unittest

from solution import dequeue_snapshot


class DequeueSnapshotTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_returns_deep_independent_snapshots_without_mutation(self):
        rows = [
            {"name": "first", "nested": [1, {"x": 2}]},
            {"name": "second", "nested": [3]},
            ["third"],
        ]
        original_first = rows[0]
        original_second = rows[1]

        first, remaining = dequeue_snapshot(rows)

        self.assertEqual(first, rows[0])
        self.assertEqual(remaining, rows[1:])
        self.assertEqual(len(rows), 3)
        self.assertIs(rows[0], original_first)
        self.assertIs(rows[1], original_second)
        self.assertIsNot(first, rows[0])
        self.assertIsNot(first["nested"], rows[0]["nested"])
        self.assertIsNot(first["nested"][1], rows[0]["nested"][1])
        self.assertIsNot(remaining, rows)
        self.assertIsNot(remaining[0], rows[1])
        self.assertIsNot(remaining[0]["nested"], rows[1]["nested"])
        self.assertIsNot(remaining[1], rows[2])

        first["nested"][1]["x"] = 99
        remaining[0]["nested"].append(4)
        self.assertEqual(rows[0]["nested"][1]["x"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(rows[1]["nested"], [3])

    def test_single_element(self):
        rows = [[{"value": 1}]]
        first, remaining = dequeue_snapshot(rows)
        self.assertEqual(first, [{"value": 1}])
        self.assertEqual(remaining, [])
        self.assertIsNot(first, rows[0])
        self.assertIsNot(first[0], rows[0][0])
        self.assertEqual(rows, [[{"value": 1}]])

    def test_empty_list(self):
        rows = []
        first, remaining = dequeue_snapshot(rows)
        self.assertIsNone(first)
        self.assertEqual(remaining, [])
        self.assertIsNot(remaining, rows)

    def test_non_list_raises_type_error(self):
        for rows in [None, (), "rows", {"a": 1}]:
            with self.subTest(rows=rows):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    dequeue_snapshot(rows)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
